name: ACAP Service Watchdog
description: Every 10 minutes (via cron), check if a dependent ACAP application is still active via its VAPIX event state. If the ACAP reports as inactive (crashed or stopped), restart it via ACAP Control, restore a device parameter to its known-good value, and publish an alert to MQTT. Demonstrates cron schedule, vapix_event_state condition, acap_control, and set_device_param.

actions.message: ACAP watchdog: restarted com.example.youracap on {{camera.serial}} at {{timestamp}}
